summary: The marketing team is juggling several high-priority initiatives, with the China Going-Global report and SEO focus on Asia Star and Intelligent China leading the charge, while operational issues like the Outlook lockout and website redesign demand immediate attention.
summaryDetail: The most critical project is the joint CKGSB-IE report 'The New Chinese Playbook for Going Global', which is on track for an early September launch at Tech in Asia or a Tyson event in Singapore; the team is currently translating the research, preparing a one-pager proposal, and exploring launch platforms. Concurrently, SEO and marketing efforts are being prioritized for Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with a focus on audience analysis and conversion tracking, and Berkeley as a potential third priority. Urgent this week: resolving the Outlook account lockout (delete and re-login on all devices), providing feedback on Joseph's website redesign (which needs to differentiate from the current site), and expediting the social media agency selection (leaning toward Media Minds). Upcoming: mid-year review draft due Aug 10, coordination with Tech in Asia for an interview on AI-driven micro-dramas, and finalizing the website menu and brochure updates.
